headerDisplay: Brings Abode garage doors, door locks, switches, dimmers and bulbs into HomeKit. Consider a dedicated Abode user for Homebridge.
footerDisplay: If your Abode account uses two-factor authentication, paste the authenticator **setup key** (not a 6-digit code) into *2FA Secret*. See the README for how to get it.

mfaSecret.title: 2FA Secret (authenticator setup key)
mfaSecret.description: Only needed if two-factor authentication is on. The base32 key shown when you set up the authenticator app in Abode (e.g. JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP). The plugin generates the 6-digit code itself each time it signs in.

exclude.title: Exclude devices
exclude.description: Device names or IDs to leave out of HomeKit.

pollingInterval.title: Polling interval (minutes)
pollingInterval.description: Backup full refresh in addition to Abode's live updates. 0 turns it off.
